title: Career and direction, 2026–2029
subtitle: A worked example on a synthetic chart — not a real person

engine.calculation: local Swiss Ephemeris (Lahiri, mean nodes, whole-sign houses)
notes: VedAstro counts dasha years as 360 days, so its period dates run earlier than the local engine's; the local dates are used here.

summary.headline: Work is the strongest area of this chart: authority built slowly through skill and trust. The next two years shift the emphasis from proving yourself to building a stable base, with a clearer step up from late 2026.

key_points.text: A career built on competence and responsibility rather than luck; recognition arrives later than effort but it lasts.
From October 2026 the chapter turns toward consolidation — a settled role, property or a home base may matter as much as a title.
The most concrete opening for a step up falls from mid-2027 into 2028.
Money follows work steadily; income is better supported than windfalls or speculation.

units.theme: Authority earned through skill, not given by position
units.meaning: You do best where competence is visible and responsibility grows with it. Structures, long projects and people who depend on your judgement bring out the best in you.
units.manifestation: Most likely a professional or institutional path — management, law, engineering, public service or anything with standards and seniority — rather than a quick entrepreneurial run.
units.nuance: The drive is strong, but it is paired with caution: you tend to prepare longer than others would.
units.counter: Your communication and money-planning side is weaker than your work drive; decisions about pay and negotiation may lag behind your actual value.
units.watch: When you are handed responsibility before the title, that is the pattern working, not being ignored.
units.basis: Saturn, which rules both the 9th and 10th houses for a Taurus ascendant, sits in its own sign with exalted Mars; the ascendant lord Venus occupies the 10th, aspected by Jupiter.

sections.title: The chapter you are in
sections.text:
You are in a long chapter (mid-2014 to late 2031) that favours learning, trade in ideas, and income through networks and groups. Its first half was about finding footing; the sub-period that ends in early October 2026 has been restless, with more change of direction than you probably wanted.

The next sub-period, from October 2026 to January 2029, keeps the same backdrop but changes the tone: less scattering, more building. It is a period for choosing one base and deepening it.

units.theme: From proving yourself to building a base
units.meaning: The coming period rewards consolidation: a role you can grow into, a place you can settle, commitments that compound.
units.manifestation: A move to a steadier employer or a more permanent position is likelier than a dramatic career change; a home or property decision may run alongside.
units.timing: The chapter opens in October 2026; the sharper stretch is mid-2027 to 2028, when the long period and the slow transits point at the same part of the chart.
units.nuance: Growth here is steady rather than sudden; the gains show over two years, not two months.
units.counter: The same period carries some hidden costs — expenses, relocation logistics or a stretch of work behind the scenes — especially while Saturn crosses your twelfth sector from mid-2027.
units.watch: An offer or reorganisation between mid-2027 and mid-2028 that gives you more responsibility and a more permanent footing.
units.basis: Mercury–Jupiter sub-period 2026-10-03 → 2029-01-07 (local engine); Jupiter rules the 11th and occupies the 4th. Jupiter enters Leo (4th) on 2026-10-31, returns to Cancer 2027-01-24, re-enters Leo 2027-06-26. Saturn enters Aries (12th) 2027-06-03, returns 2027-10-20, re-enters 2028-02-23.

units.theme: Income tracks effort; windfalls are not the story
units.meaning: Earnings grow with responsibility and through networks, clients or institutions rather than through luck.
units.manifestation: Better-paid roles, consulting on the side, or income from a group or organisation you belong to.
units.counter: Savings discipline is the weaker link; plan for the relocation and household costs that the next period brings.
units.watch: Whether the 2027–28 step up comes with a clear pay change — if not, negotiate it rather than waiting.
units.basis: Sun and debilitated Mercury (2nd and 5th lord) in the 11th; 11th lord Jupiter in the 4th, vargottama.

timeline.label: Step up most likely
timeline.basis: sub-period lord and Jupiter's return to the 4th agree

watch_list.sign: A settling decision: role, place or both
More responsibility with a more permanent footing
watch_list.meaning: The main window is working; if nothing comes, treat 2027–28 as preparation

uncertainty.birth_time: The ascendant is late in Taurus (about 27°); a birth about 14 minutes later (calculated) would make it Gemini and change every house. The dasha dates do not depend on this.
engine_differences: VedAstro's 360-day years put the October 2026 sub-period change in April 2026; the local engine's sidereal years are used here.
not_assessed: Health, family and relationships are outside the scope of this report.

practical_summary: Treat October 2026 onwards as a time to choose one base and deepen it.
Prepare for a step up from mid-2027: make your responsibility visible and ask for the title to match.
Budget for the logistics that come with growth in 2027–28.

appendix.method: Parashari, whole-sign houses from the sidereal ascendant; Vimshottari with 365.256-day years; transit sign changes calculated, not estimated.
sources: Yogakaraka for Taurus ascendant (Saturn as 9th and 10th lord): standard Parashari doctrine; see the skill's source index for page references.
